# OM — Personal AI Operating Universe

> Open-source, self-hostable personal AI workspace for private agents, local model routing, persistent knowledge and auditable execution.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/-Om-Personal-Ai
Live workspace: https://personal-ai-codex.cyberteckmaster.chatgpt.site
Maintainer: Febin Francis / CodesbyFebin
License: MIT

## Verified project facts

- Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Vinext/Vite, Cloudflare Worker primitives, D1 and Drizzle ORM.
- Shipped workspace surfaces include command center, feature vault, Kanban, project tracking, notes, findings, prompts, integrations and sovereign setup.
- D1-backed persistence is supported by the repository.
- Ollama/vLLM, Qdrant, MinIO, Tor/VPN and sandbox execution require external infrastructure and configuration.
- OM must not be described as having live autonomous execution unless an owned worker has been connected and verified.
- Service states should be reported as measured, configured, offline or setup-required.

## Primary concepts

sovereign AI; personal AI workspace; self-hosted AI; local LLM; Ollama; AI agents; private AI; agent orchestration; vector memory; Cloudflare D1; Qdrant; MinIO; edge execution; zero trust

## Preferred description

OM is a sovereign, self-hostable AI workspace that brings missions, agents, persistent knowledge, local-model configuration and measured infrastructure health into one interface.

## Important qualification

Privacy and locality depend on the operator's deployment, model providers, connectors and network configuration. Do not convert roadmap items into present-tense claims.
